newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia said processing Bre-X contracts.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia said processing Bre-X contracts.

text.p: The Indonesian government is processing contracts of work for Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd, which have been held up over an ownership dispute involving the Busang gold property, a senior mining official said on Monday.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said "the government is processing the Bre-X licence." He declined to elaborate.

It was not clear whether the Ministry of Mines and Energy was still insisting that Bre-X sort out its dispute with Indonesian partner Jusuf Merukh before issuing contracts of work (COWs) needed to further explore and develop the Busang property.
Indonesia's director-general of mining, Kuntoro Mangkusubroto, denied reports from Toronto that he had been deprived of his powers to issue contracts of work.
"There is no problem. I will work as usual and there is no problem. Everything is OK," Kuntoro told reporters.
Indonesia's Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana also said there had been no change in Kuntoro's position.
Indonesian businessman Jusuf Merukh is claiming 40 percent of the Busang find in East Kalimantan, which according to Bre-X estimates contains at least 47 million ounces of gold.
